Application Security

Validation de la logique métier

The process of systematically verifying application workflows and rules to ensure that implemented business logic enforces intended controls, prevents abuse, and resists circumvention or manipulation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Validation de la logique métier?

In this glossary, Validation de la logique métier refers to: The process of systematically verifying application workflows and rules to ensure that implemented business logic enforces intended controls, prevents abuse, and resists circumvention or manipulation.

How is Validation de la logique métier used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Réalisez une validation approfondie de la logique métier pour garantir que seules les transactions légitimes sont autorisées et que tous les scénarios d'abus sont atténués."
